ModbusCmd.Title: get_state
ModbusCmd.HintText: Get device state (on/off). 1 = off 2 = on 3 = connected (if internally connected to the grid) 4 = standby

ModbusCmd.Title: get_soc
ModbusCmd.Comment: State of charge of the battery in percent.
ModbusCmd.HintText: State of charge of the battery in percent (%).

ModbusCmd.Title: get_power
ModbusCmd.Comment: Actual power of charging/discharging in kilowatts.
ModbusCmd.HintText:
Actual power of charging/discharging in kilowatts. positive = discharge negative = charge
Value from device in watts, already converted in kilowatts by value correction. You have to substract 16,384 from this value!!!

ModbusCmd.Title: get_power_meter
ModbusCmd.Comment: Get power from connected electricity meter in kilowatts
ModbusCmd.HintText:
Get power from connected electricity meter in kilowatts positive = consumption negative = delivery
Value from device in watts, already converted in kilowatts by value correction. You have to substract 16,384 from this value!!!

ModbusCmd.Title: set_power
ModbusCmd.HintText:
Set power charging/discharging in kilowatts. positive value = discharge negative value = charge
Have to be set in watts for the device. Already converted to watts in value correction.

ModbusCmd.Title: set_cosPhi
ModbusCmd.HintText: Set power fator. Conversion of 1000! To set cos phi of 0,95 you have to set 950. Already converted in value correction.

ModbusCmd.Title: set_max_dischargepower
ModbusCmd.Comment: Set maximum power of discharge in kilowatts.
ModbusCmd.HintText: Set maximum power of discharge in kilowatts. Have to be set in watts for the device. Already converted to watts in value correction.

ModbusCmd.Title: set_max_chargepower
ModbusCmd.Comment: Set maximum power of charging in kilowatts.
ModbusCmd.HintText: Set maximum power of charging in kilowatts. Have to be set in watts for the device. Already converted to watts in value correction.
